69300.meaning1: fact of purity; pure state; purity

examples.text: tañ'ca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa. ijjhat'āvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi visuddhattā.
api dūragatā saramhase, āyatapamhe visuddhadassane, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattarā, nayanā kinnarimandalocane.

69302.meaning1: having clear vision; seeing clearly; (comm) having omniscient knowledge (of)

examples.text: sv'āhaṃ akaṅkho asito anūpayo, sabbesu dhammesu visuddhadassano, pappuyya sambodhim'anuttaraṃ sivaṃ, jhāyām'ahaṃ brahma raho visārado'ti.

69303.meaning1: one's own purification; oneself as purified
69303.commentary: (MNa) visuddham'attānaṃ samanupassatī'ti attānaṃ visujjhantaṃ passati. visuddho'ti pana na tāva vattabbo.

examples.text: tassa sabbehi imehi pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi visuddham'attānaṃ samanupassato vimuttamattānaṃ samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.

69304.commentary: (KVa) visuddh'āpekkho'ti attano gihibhāv'ādikaṃ visuddhiṃ apekkhamāno icchamāno. (VINa) visuddh'āpekkho'ti attano visuddhiṃ apekkhamāno icchamāno patthayamāno.

examples.text: sampajānamusāvādo kho pan'āyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā, tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddh'āpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā, āvikatā hi'ssa phāsu hoti.
tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā āpanno visuddh'āpekkho evaṃ vadeyya ajānam'evaṃ āvuso avacaṃ jānāmi, apassaṃ passāmi
es'eva maggo n'atth'añño, dassanassa visuddhiyā, etañ'hi tumhe paṭipajjatha, mārass'etaṃ pamohanaṃ.
sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.

69308.meaning1: pure in nature; (or) able to purify oneself

69309.meaning1: Path of Purification; commentarial treatise by Buddhaghosa

examples.text: tena vuttaṃ yath'ānusandhivasena desanā āgatā'ti. brahmavihāresu pana anupadavaṇṇanā ca bhāvanānayo ca sabbo sabb'ākārena visuddhimagge vutto.
hoti so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ mahāsamuddo ussussati visussati na bhavati, na tv'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
kamaṃ aṭṭhānupassanā, yojetvāna visuṃ visuṃ, sampiṇḍitesu sabbesu, honti pañca satāni ca, aṭṭhavīsati suttāni, āhuneyye ca vaggike.

aggihoman'ti evarūpena dārunā evaṃ hute idaṃ nāma hotī'ti aggijuhanaṃ. dabbihom'ādīni'pi aggihomān'eva, evarūpāya dabbiyā īdisehi kaṇ'ādīhi hute idaṃ nāma hotī'ti evaṃ pavattivasena pana visuṃ vuttāni.
nacca-gīta-vādita-visūka-dassanā paṭivirato hoti mālā-gandha-vilepana-dhāraṇa-maṇḍana-vibhūsana-ṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti

69316.commentary: (NIDD2) diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivatto'ti diṭṭhivisūkāni vuccanti vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhī. (MNa) sammādiṭṭhiyā vinivijjhan'aṭṭhena viloman'aṭṭhena vā visūkaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ.

69318.commentary: (MNa) sāsanassa ananulomattā visūkaṃ paṭāṇībhūtaṃ dassanan'ti visūkadassanaṃ. (ANa) visūkadassanan'ti visūkabhūtaṃ dassanaṃ.

examples.text: nacca-gīta-vādita-visūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti mālā-gandha-vilepana-dhāraṇa-maṇḍana-vibhūsana-ṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
indriyesu guttadvārassa visūkadassanaṃ kaṇṭako, brahmacariyassa mātugām'ūpacāro kaṇṭako, paṭhamassa jhānassa saddo kaṇṭako, dutiyassa jhānassa vitakkavicārā kaṇṭakā

evañ'hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi sañchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ otarituṃ. evam'eva kho, bhante, yāni kānici visūkāyikāni visevitāni vipphanditāni, sabbāni tāni bhagavatā sañchinnāni sambhaggāni sampalibhaggāni.

evam'eva kho, bhante, yāni saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni tāni'pi sabbāni bhagavatā sañchinnāni sambhaggāni sampalibhaggāni, abhabbo ca dāni, bhante, saccako nigaṇṭhaputto puna bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ yadidaṃ vād'ādhippāyo'ti.

tassa mukh'ādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa honti'y'eva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici, yathā taṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa. so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pakkhandikā sūlā visūcikā kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso soso apamāro daddu kaṇḍu kacchu nakhasā vitacchikā lohitaṃ pittaṃ madhumeho aṃsā piḷakā bhagandalā

69323.grammar: fem, in comps, from senā, neg

69324.grammar: fem, in comps, from visenā, neg

examples.text: visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.
sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam'eva dassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.

69325.grammar: abs of visenikaroti, comp vb, used as adj, neg, intrans
69325.meaning1: having disarmed; not opposing; at peace; (or) having disassociated; (comm) having destroyed the army of defilements
69325.meaningLit: having made army-less; having made without association

examples.text: na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, mun'īdha nanda kusalā vadanti, visenikatvā anīghā nirāsā, caranti ye te munayoti brūmi.
visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.

69326.meaning1: disarmed (wrt); not opposing; at peace (with); (or) disassociated (from); (comm) who has conquered the army of Māra
69326.commentary: (SNa) visenibhūto'ti kilesasenāya viseno jāto. (SNPa) sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā'ti so bhūripañño khīṇ'āsavo yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā mutaṃ vā tesu sabbadhammesu mārasenaṃ vināsetvā ṭhitabhāvena visenibhūto. (NIDD1a) visenibhūto'ti nikkileso hutvā ṭhito.

examples.text: sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam'eva dassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.
sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sa pannabhāro muni vippamutto, na kappiyo n'ūparato na patthiyo'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako apacināti no ācināti, pajahati no upādiyati, viseneti no usseneti, vidhūpeti no sandhūpeti

69328.meaning1: (of an army) having disarmed; having disbanded; having dissolved

examples.text: kiñ'ca n'eva viseneti na usseneti visenetvā ṭhito? rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṃkhare… viññāṇaṃ n'eva viseneti na usseneti visenetvā ṭhito

69329.commentary: (MNa) uḷāraṃ pubben'āparaṃ visesaṃ jānantī'ti sīlaparipūraṇ'ādito pubbavisesato uḷārataraṃ aparaṃ kasiṇaparikamm'ādivisesaṃ jānantī'ti attho.

examples.text: ṭhitena kāyena ṭhitena cetasā, tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayāno, etaṃ satiṃ bhikkhu adhiṭṭhahāno, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche'ti.
te ca navā bhikkhū therehi bhikkhūhi ovadiyamānā anusāsiyamānā uḷāraṃ pubben'āparaṃ visesaṃ jānanti.
na vedanaṃ vedayati sapañño, sukham'pi dukkham'pi bahussuto'pi, ayañ'ca dhīrassa puthujjanena, mahā viseso kusalassa hoti.
idha no, āvuso, ko viseso, ko adhippayāso, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin'ti?
tatra yā assa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa, yañ'ca khv'assa tatra sappi vā telaṃ vā taṃ uddhagāmi assa visesagāmi.

69333.meaning1: reaching distinction; attaining a superior state
69333.commentary: (ANa) atha so satto khippaṃ'y'eva visesagāmī hoti, nibbānagāmī hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ idh'eva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti siṅgālā vā khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti, yañ'ca khv'assa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ… taṃ uddhagāmi hoti visesagāmi.
so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati. tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadā plavanti. dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo, atha so satto khippaṃ'y'eva visesagāmī hoti.

69334.commentary: (JAa) visesagū'ti visesagamano hutvā tusitapure nibbatto homī'ti vadati.

examples.text: yaṃ te dhammaṃ idh'aññāya, visesaṃ ajjhagaṃsu te, kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ, duve tesaṃ visesagū.
ito vimuccamān'āhaṃ, saggagāmī visesagū, anivatti tato assaṃ, aṭṭham'etaṃ varaṃ vare.

69335.meaning1: more distinguished; more superior; more eminent

examples.text: gandhabbakāy'ūpagatā bhavanto, devānam'āgacchatha pāricariyaṃ, agāre vasato mayhaṃ, imaṃ passa visesataṃ.

69337.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of visesa

examples.text: evaṃ visesato ñatvā, appamādamhi paṇḍitā, appamāde pamodanti, ariyānaṃ gocare ratā.

so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

69341.meaning2: (gram) kammadhāraya with second member qualifying first

69342.meaning2: (gram) kammadhāraya with first member qualifying second

examples.text: eko, āvuso, dhammo bahukāro, eko dhammo bhāvetabbo, eko dhammo pariññeyyo, eko dhammo pahātabbo, eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo, eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo, eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho, eko dhammo uppādetabbo, eko dhammo abhiññeyyo, eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.
katamo eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo? yoniso manasikāro. ayaṃ eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo.

69344.meaning1: matter which is conducive to distinction

69345.meaning1: attainment of distinction; achievement of eminence

examples.text: na oramattakena vises'ādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpajjissanti

69346.grammar: adj, masc nom sg, irreg form of visesī

examples.text: diṭṭhim'pi lokasmiṃ na kappayeyya, ñāṇena vā sīlavatena vā'pi, samo'ti attānam'anūpaneyya, hīno na maññetha visesi vā'pi.
parassa ce vambhayitena hīno, na koci dhammesu visesi assa, puthū hi aññassa vadanti dhammaṃ, nihīnato sam'hi daḷhaṃ vadānā.

69350.commentary: (SNa) samo visesī'ti na tassa hotī'ti tassa pahīnamānassa khīṇ'āsavassa ahaṃ sadiso'ti vā seyyo'ti vā hīno'ti vā na hotī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: samo visesī uda vā nihīno, yo maññatī so vivadetha tena, tīsu vidhāsu avikampamāno, samo visesī'ti na tassa hoti, sace vijānāsi vadehi yakkhā'ti.
te aññe atirocanti, vaṇṇena yasasāyunā, sāvakā bhūripaññassa, vises'ūpagatā idha.

69353.meaning2: having qualified, having defined, having distinguished

69354.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of visesa

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhante, yāni saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni tāni'pi sabbāni bhagavatā sañchinnāni sambhaggāni sampalibhaggāni, abhabbo ca dāni, bhante, saccako nigaṇṭhaputto puna bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ yadidaṃ vād'ādhippāyo'ti.
tassa mukh'ādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa honti y'eva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici, yathā taṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa.
gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.
uttarī'ti āraddhataruṇavipassanassa rāg'ādiparissayā ce uppajjeyyuṃ, tesaṃ visodhan'atthaṃ tato uddhaṃ cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā uppādetabbā vaḍḍhetabbā ca.
attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attanā saṃkilissati, attanā akataṃ pāpaṃ, attanā'va visujjhati, suddhī asuddhi paccattaṃ, n'āñño aññaṃ visodhaye.
vāc'ānurakkhī manasā susaṃvuto, kāyena ca n'ākusalaṃ kayirā, ete tayo kammapathe visodhaye, ārādhaye maggam'isippaveditaṃ.
katā me kalyāṇā anekarūpā, yaññā yiṭṭhā ye vipulā pasatthā, visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.

69361.commentary: (THa) dibbacakkhu visodhitan'ti dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ… visuddhaṃ katvā paṭiladdhan'ti attho.

examples.text: tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna, ekam'ante upāvisiṃ, pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ.

saddhā sīlena sampannā, vadaññū vītamaccharā, niccaṃ maggaṃ visodheti, sotthānaṃ samparāyikaṃ.
tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma na cakkhūni uppādeyya, na cakkhūni visodheyya.

69375.meaning2: causes to dry up, makes wither
69375.commentary: (NIDD1) yaṃ pubbe taṃ visosehī'ti. atīte saṅkhāre ārabbha ye kilesā uppajjeyyuṃ te kilese sosehi visosehi sukkhāpehi visukkhāpehi abījaṃ karohi pajaha vinodehi byantiṃ karohi anabhāvaṃ gamehī'ti.

yaṃ pubbe taṃ visosehi, pacchā te m'āhu kiñcanaṃ, majjhe ce no gahessasi, upasanto carissasi.

69376.meaning2: having caused to dry up, having made wither

so taṃ thūṇaṃ khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya. khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chetvā phāleyya. phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ katvā vāt'ātape visoseyya. vāt'ātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya.
